hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null) || cmd=$input; printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+(create|new)([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 2; if git notes --ref=review show HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "HEAD ($(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)) has no review note, so the pull request is refused. Review the change first with the pre-pr-review skill (/code-review, then the gate), then mark this exact commit: git notes --ref=review add -m '<what the review found and what happened to it>' HEAD. A new commit, an amend or a rebase moves HEAD, and the new HEAD needs its own note." >&2; exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that this change was reviewed
